operator_request: 17.10.2026: Klargjør og gjennomfør første P0-utviklingstest; macro-free common control; eight arms, bounded rule/tree fits, no native training/TEST/live/spending.
macro_control: Remove exactly all 61 native D1 macro/panel/positioning fields from every research arm. Keep observations in November/December 2025. Native 315-field baseline is immutable. No unqualified macro proxies or missing flags added.
primary_rationale: Short intraday markout for new book and rolling15 information; modest funding exposure and all common windows have exact observed M1 paths. Chosen before fitting; not selected on prediction/economics. Target horizon is not a holding limit.
secondary_interpretation: Direction/forecast transfer diagnostics of the SAME h30 forecast on separately strict path-qualified outcomes; no secondary fitting or model selection; unadjusted scale MSE is descriptive.

tree.selection: One fixed small GBDT, 64 rounds, depth4, 15 leaves, min500; no search or early stopping. Existing M5 histogram tree owner/library reused.

rule.logic: Sum signs of included trend/OFI/VWAP continuation votes; V conditions on TRAIN RV terciles; forecast TRAIN mean observed mid-markout by exact state. Unseen state is missing evidence => FLAT. No vote threshold search, stops, time exits or unanimity requirement.

decision_and_execution: Closed M5 at t, signal execution at exact t+60sec M1 OPEN quote. Last closed M1 spread at decision plus declared fee and h30 projected funding used for expected-value argmax; ties/missing evidence FLAT. Missing execution quote rejects change and retains old position.
strategy: At every common input-qualified timestamp, choose argmax(expected LONG net, expected SHORT net, FLAT=0). Forecast is mid bps; decision uses +/- forecast minus decision-known spread, fees and horizon funding. Actual accounting uses entry-side notional, bid/ask and elapsed wall-clock financing v3. One position, fixed 1x initial-equity notional; no compounding, sizing fit, stop or max hold. Hold through missing input windows/closures and fold changes. Only model FLAT/flip closes. Final open position is marked, not forcibly exited; reserve full round-trip fee at entry.
matching: Identical decision population, train/evaluation folds, one-position risk budget, action rule, economic owner and scenarios in all arms. Strategies can select different entries/exposure. Future exact-path eligibility is for target training/metrics only, never used to decide a strategy action. Costs scenarios keep central-model signals and trade ledger fixed.
uncertainty: Paired calendar-week block bootstrap, 4000 replicates; seven incremental-vs-CORE contrasts separately for tree primary and rule descriptive families; raw95% and family99.2857% intervals; approximation conditional on fixed fitted folds. Monthly/fold results disclosed. No untouched confirmation.
